item.title: ASEAN Summit LIVE updates: President Trump arrives in Manila to hold discussions with Quad leaders
item.description: In the first Quad Summit since 2024, PM Modi is expected to meet U.S. President Trump, Japanese PM Takaichi and Australian PM Albanese

item.title: Ajit Pawar plane crash: Rohit Pawar questions CM Devendra Fadnavis’ links with VSR Ventures
item.description: Presenting a 49-page slideshow containing photographs, videos, flight records and documents, Mr. Pawar questioned why an FIR had not been registered in Maharashtra despite repeated complaints and why the investigation had not been handed over to the CBI

item.title: Nearly 40 students of KGBV at Gummagatta in Andhra’s Anantapur district fall ill after dinner
item.description: Ten students are shifted to the primary health centre; the DEO orders an inquiry

item.title: BJP chief Nitin Nabin reaches Mathura for U.P. poll strategy meeting
item.description: BJP's Uttar Pradesh media convenor Manish Dixit said that State party president and Union Minister of State for Finance Pankaj Chaudhary and the party's State in-charge Vinod Tawde welcomed Nabin at the helipad upon his arrival on November 17 afternoon
